title: Persevere
scene: A middle-school student in a green hoodie at a desk keeps working on a simple wooden block structure after a small earlier attempt collapsed beside it. The student carefully places one block with the right hand while the left steadies the base. A patient teacher sits nearby ready to help, hands resting naturally. Show quiet determination and trying again, not frustration or celebration.
alt: A student carefully rebuilds a small block structure beside an earlier collapsed attempt while a teacher sits ready to help.
